AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-30-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: ELLEN CHAITIN, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha , CSR: B. Fields, #7235

Petitioner Cynthia Joy was present in pro per for and with the Minor Robert Stanleu, placed under oath and examined.
Letter dated 03-28-11 by Laurence F. Mirels, MD. Assoc. Chief, Division of Infectious Diseases of Santa Clara Valley Medical Center, presented to the court regarding the disabilities of Mr. Ronnie Stanley (minor's father).
Proof of Publication was filed.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the minor to Robert Joy.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-16-2011 Off Calendar
